title: Publish advisory service-authored NIP-65 relay preferences
intent: Expose standard service read/write relay hints for wider Nostr routing without replacing Bahia ContextVM discovery and NIP-51 relay-set bootstrap.
observed_before: System discovery projection published ContextVM discovery plus service-authored NIP-51 30002 relay sets, but no service-authored NIP-65 10002 relay preference event.
intended_behavior: When sidecar system discovery projection runs, the configured Bahia service key signs and publishes kind 10002. The event contains r tags with read markers for ContextVM request/read relays and write markers for service publish/backfill relays. Bahia clients continue treating ContextVM discovery and NIP-51 30002 relay sets as canonical bootstrap; kind 10002 remains advisory.
out_of_scope: relay metadata and DM relay-list follow-up
